create_LVISEvaluator: create an LVISEvaluator instance to evaluate LVIS dataset predictions with configurable tasks and output directory
process_LVISEvaluator: process model inputs and outputs to collect LVIS predictions for later evaluation
evaluate_LVISEvaluator: evaluate collected LVIS predictions and return AP metrics for bbox and segmentation tasks
evaluate_box_proposals: evaluate detection proposal recall metrics using pairwise IoU against ground truth boxes
evaluate_predictions_on_lvis: evaluate LVIS predictions against ground truth annotations and return per-category AP scores
